status: Baseline attribution control only; no production closing fix is measured.

sourceManifest.buildState: Temporary developer-harness entry point, corrected bare-window probe and default-process heap census over this base. The shared launcher/test guard was also pending; no clean-head benchmark claim.
sourceRoles: App.DeveloperHarness.cs is the clean base backup, verified with CRLF normalized.
App.DeveloperHarness.instrumented.cs adds the exact temporary-closing-census entry point.
App.TemporaryClosingCensus.corrected.cs is the measured corrected probe; the earlier uncorrected source is excluded.
App.TemporaryNativeHeapWalk.cs is the census helper. The corrected controller launches fresh children through Arguments and validates exit/report/census completion.
sourceManifest.excludedAttempt: The earlier closing run used unsupported ArgumentList, launched without the intended diagnostic arguments and produced no control reports. It is excluded; no observations from that run are allocation evidence.

experiment.processes: One fresh process/private desktop per mode, hide then close; identical pinned app/SDK binaries.
experiment.surface: One bare Window containing a Grid, shown offscreen without activation; one cached AppWindow with Closing subscribed.
experiment.warmup: Both modes perform three canceled closes and three direct hides before collection; both record exactly three callbacks.
experiment.closeMode: Each of 200 cycles sends WM_CLOSE. The Closing handler increments its counter, sets Cancel=true and hides the AppWindow.
experiment.hideMode: Each of 200 cycles calls AppWindow.Hide directly with the same Closing subscription still installed.
experiment.postcondition: After every cycle, dispatcher draining verifies the window is hidden and its original HWND is still valid and unchanged.
experiment.retirement: Before each census: dispatcher drain, forced full GC, finalizer wait, another forced full GC, then dispatcher drain. Final idle additionally waits three seconds.
experiment.censusBoundary: All censuses precede unsubscription and final window destruction. The final close after unsubscription is outside the measurements.
experiment.hardwareAndService: Disconnected developer-only bare-window probe; no service client or hardware operation is created by its body.

symbolResolution.method: Read-only offline CDB exact-symbol lookup in an earlier saved idle dump using cached matching PDB symbols; no live process attached.
symbolResolution.limit: The earlier dump is used only for type resolution, not for either control count. Its matching module/PDB identity and unchanged Windowing hash bind these RVAs.

censusValidation.scope: Locked default-process HeapWalk; allocated-block first words grouped by module-relative address.

result.interpretation: Each canceled-close callback is associated with one additional retained ClosingArgs/adapter group across the measured checkpoints. Direct hiding stays flat after the same warmup. Counts remain unchanged over the final three-second idle/collection interval.

limits: Only 200 cycles and the stated retirement interval were measured; not an indefinite-retention proof.
The native Window and Closing subscription remain live during all censuses; cleanup after unsubscribe, true destruction or process exit is unmeasured.
The count slope identifies native types, not their final retaining reference or a direct allocation/release stack.
Payload totals exclude allocator overhead. Default-heap counts do not cover every heap, mapping, private byte or handle; those process-wide trends were not recorded by this probe.
No production fix, full-solution validation, installed-product behavior or Claude review is established by this artifact.
privacy: Only basenames, module RVAs, counts and hashes are exported. Raw addresses, handles, PIDs, private paths and user data remain outside the repository.
